messages.en:
Foooooooore!{01 01 00}
Say hey! Nice work putting
me together like that.
It seems like I've been
waiting in this brutal
winter cold forever!
Just waiting and waiting for
a nice kid like you to come
along and finish me.
I didn't know what was
gonna come first...
You or spring!
I felt like one of them
hamsters in a wheel! Just
rolling in place...
Aw, but seriously!{01 00 00 05 00} I'm real
happy you came along.

Lihtsalt oodanud ja oodanud

Ma ei teadnud, mis
enne tuleb...
Sina või kevad!
Tundsin end nagu hamster
rattas! Lihtsalt
paigal veeredes...
Aga tõsiselt!{01 00 00 05 00} Olen väga
rõõmus, et sa tulid.
